correctness.rationale: The only boundary equilibrium is zero: a zero component nullifies infection in all other equations, while no component equal to one can be stationary. At positive equilibria multiplication by xᵢ gives the stated scalar parametrization with s=λ times the product of the components. The log-elasticity sum decreases strictly from n/2 to zero; the level function diverges at both ends and has a nondegenerate unique minimum, giving the claimed exact root counts. At an interior equilibrium the Jacobian is diagonally similar to a symmetric positive rank-one perturbation of a negative diagonal; a positive diagonal congruence reduces its inertia test to the elasticity sum crossing one. For the dynamical fold, the left zero eigenvector can be chosen strictly positive from the rank-one kernel and the positive diagonal similarities, so its pairing with F_λ is positive. Differentiating F(X(s),L(s))=0 twice and pairing with that eigenvector at s* gives the quadratic pairing along X′(s*) as minus L″(s*) times this positive pairing. It is nonzero, which verifies the simple saddle-node conditions. At zero the Jacobian is −diag(rᵢ) because n≥3. Direct differentiation gives the exact weighted-gradient identity. Upper faces are left immediately and the logarithmic term traps the orbit in a compact sublevel with strictly positive gradient weights; LaSalle puts the limit set in the finite equilibrium set. The connectedness of the limit set then gives convergence, including at the fold and for initial points on lower faces. Strict concavity of log φ(exp u) gives Jensen and strict Karamata inequalities at each finite s; evaluating at the more heterogeneous vector's attained minimizer preserves strictness. Implicit smoothness of the minimizing s and the envelope identity give the stated sensitivity and sum. Independent numerical replay `python3 /workspace/branches/independent-replay.py 1` reproduced the five folds and checked the stationary identities, derivative values and one strict fixed-mean majorization comparison; the analytic proof establishes the general statements.
residual_risks: Only the deterministic pure single-edge model is established. The weighted-gradient proof makes no claim about overlapping edges, additional channels or a finite stochastic SIS process.

evidence: The Cui et al. results inspected give sufficient extinction/endemic conditions and almost-everywhere convergence under additional hypotheses. The Cisneros-Velarde–Bullo bistability theorem requires an irreducible pairwise matrix and is sufficient. The Higham–de Kergorlay result is a sufficient spectral extinction bound. The complete multipartite Resultary theorem shares a fold but uses common rates and balances group sizes.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Neither sufficient bounds nor almost-everywhere convergence imply the exact fold and convergence for every initial state at criticality. Changing group sizes in a homogeneous model does not yield continuous majorization of log individual rates at fixed product.

originality.rationale: No inspected statement covers the combined individualized-ratio exact fold, strict log-majorization, and all-trajectory convergence including at the fold. The strongest heterogeneous node-based paper already contains the model as a special case, and the nearest Resultary exact-fold theorem covers the homogeneous single-edge specialization, so neither novelty of the general model nor of the homogeneous fold is credited. The distinction is exact classification, quantitative balancing of individual ratios, and global convergence in the heterogeneous special case.
residual_risks: The discrete-Euler support criterion cited without a bibliographic locator was not independently located. The Bodó full text was not inspected; the public web lookup returned no pertinent evidence. These limitations do not establish noncoverage or priority.

value.rationale: A single genuinely higher-order conjunctive interaction is a natural building block rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The result gives the exact size and direction of the heterogeneity effect through a strict ordering and coordinate sensitivities, and it separates global convergence of individual trajectories from mere local stability, including at the degenerate parameter. These are useful model-level conclusions even without a result for overlapping edges.
residual_risks: No stochastic persistence, epidemiological calibration or general hypergraph extension follows from this theorem.
